SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7165
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date April 22, 1937.
Subject Anti-Soviet Propaganda Distributed in Shanghai
Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by J Boyne D.S.I

With reference to the sets of pictures (attached),
depicting atrocities alleged to have been committed by the
"Red" forces in Spain, I have to report that after a
careful examination of the type and texture of the paper
under a magnifying glass, it is the considered opinion of
an expert that the pictures and booklet were not printed in
China. It is his further opinion that they emanate from
Germany. A knowledge of German printing work generally
and peculiarities of type used in the captions under the
pictures led to this opinion.

The post mark on the larger envelope indicates
that it was received at the 9th sub-office, 100 Carter Road
at 10 a.m. April 16. The post office can give no details
regarding the smaller envelope owing to the indistinct
post mark.

According to a paper manufacturer the texture of
the envelopes is not of a first class quality and it would
be difficult to ascertain the firm from which they were
purchased.

D.C. (Special Branch).
J McKeown.
D. S.
22/4
FILE
DBR

（印：RECD 23 APR. SHANGHAI）

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7165
S.1，特别科
报告
日期：1937年4月22日。
事由：在上海散发的反苏宣传品
制作人：D.S. McKeown 转呈人：J Boyne D.S.I

关于所附的一套图片，其内容描绘了据称由西班牙“赤色”部队犯下的暴行，经在放大镜下仔细检查纸张的类型和质地后，专家的意见认为，这些图片和小册子并非在中国印刷。他进一步认为，这些物品源自德国。这一判断是基于对德国印刷工艺的一般了解，以及图片说明文字中所用字体的特征得出的。

较大信封上的邮戳显示，该信封于4月16日上午10时送达卡特路（Carter Road）100号第九支局。由于较小信封上的邮戳模糊不清，邮局无法提供有关该信封的详细信息。

据一家造纸商称，信封的纸质并非一流品质，因此很难查明购买这些信封的具体商行。

特别科副督察。
J McKeown。
副督察。
22/4
归档
DBR
22/4
（印：1937年4月23日收讫 上海）

FORM NO. 3
C. 104-11-35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. 2865
Special Branch Diary
Date April 10 1937.

Subject (in full) Anti-Soviet Propaganda distributed in Shanghai.

Made by/ and Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross.

I forward herewith a set of pictures showing
atrocities alleged to have been committed by the "Red" forces
at present engaged in hostilities in Spain. These pictures
were delivered through the post addressed to the German Restaurant
1204 Bubbling Well Road, on April 8, 1937. The cancellation
chop on the envelope shows that it was posted at the Head Post
Office at 1 p.m. April 7.

The pictures were obtained by the undersigned from
Mr. Frank Eder, German, proprietor of the above restaurant.

C. D. I.
Deputy Commissioner in Charge.

S.I.
（印：10 APR. 1. CHANGHAI）
D.S.I. Prokofiev.
J.B 12/4

特别科登记处
编号 2865
特别科日志
日期：1937年4月10日。

事由（全称）：在上海散发的反苏宣传品。

制作人及转呈人：C.D.I. Ross。

现随函附上一套图片，显示据称由目前在西班牙从事敌对行动的“赤色”部队犯下的暴行。这些图片于1937年4月8日通过邮政投递至静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1204号德国餐馆。信封上的销票戳记显示，该邮件于4月7日下午1时在邮政总局寄出。

上述图片由下述签署人从该餐馆老板、德籍人士 Frank Eder 先生处获得。

C. D. I.
主管副总监。

S.I.
（印：1937年4月10日 上海）
D.S.I. Prokofiev。
